Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 玩在墓地里：在墓地里玩，A location phrase should come before the main action verb. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：装作祭拜，When meaning “pretend to do an action,” use 装作 before the verb phrase. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候：孟子是一个小男孩。他小的时候，On a character’s first mention, briefly introduce the character with a name and identifying noun phrase before using a pronoun. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友：他和朋友，After the name appeared in the immediately preceding sentence and no other main character intervened, use a pronoun for the close re-occurrence. [rule: reference_form]
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，This is a completed move at age five, so the completed action needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 地点短语应放在动作动词“玩”之前。
“装祭拜”搭配不完整，“装作祭拜”可以表示假装进行祭拜。
这是角色首次出现，按老师的要求应先用名字和身份简单介绍。
“孟子”刚在前一句出现，紧接着再次指代时应使用“他”。
五岁时搬家是已经完成的过去事件，需要用“搬了家”标示完成。
